script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; d=$(mktemp -d); mkfifo "$d/f"; /bin/sh -c 'read x < "$0"' "$d/f" & jobs -sr > "$o"; kind; jobs -rs > "$o"; kind; jobs -rsr > "$o"; kind; jobs -ss > "$o"; kind; jobs -r -s -r > "$o"; kind; echo go > "$d/f"; wait; rm -rf "$d" "$o"
